text:
Sam: kicking off a region-by-region rollout for release v2.4.1-optim. plan is US -> EU -> APAC, staged canaries and warm-pool ramp. deploy-bot will do automated pinning. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started for v2.4.1-optim -> redwood-gptx-3b (quantized q4)
deploy-bot: US canary 2% traffic slice created (slotset: reserve=40 nodes, warm_pool=8)
Elena: oncall here — can confirm downstream cache priming is done for US. p50 latency baseline is 82ms. I'll watch p95 and error rates for 15m after canary. :eyes:
Priya: infra check: US warm pool health 8/8, node mem 72% avg, GPU temp nominal. Autoscaler headroom set to +25% for US.
Marcus: rollout notes: we pin traffic at model tag v2.4.1-optim for canary slices. fallback policy: auto-fallback -> redwood-gptx-3b-fp16 if error rate > 2% sustained for 3m or p95 > 1200ms for 3m. manual rollback if SLO breach > 1h.
Sam: quick checklist: (1) canary 2% US 10m smoke, (2) if ok -> 10% US ramp over 20m, (3) EU 3% canary after US steady, (4) APAC single-region smoke then staggered.
Elena: adding runtime metrics to alert rules: increase alert window to 5m for p95 spikes during ramp. also enable tracing hooks for canary flows.
Priya: capacity note for EU: current reserved pool only 28 nodes; recommend pre-warm +10 nodes before EU canary. I'll provision now and tag change window to avoid overlap with maintenance at 23:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: EU prewarm request acknowledged. Pending approval from ops-bot.
ops-bot: approved prewarm +10 nodes for EU, schedule: +10 live at 3456789120 (approx 8m).
Marcus: release notes snippet (for console): "v2.4.1-optim: inference kernel tweaks, q4 quantization profile, improved KV cache efficiency; expected cost -12% on typical chat workloads."
Sam: rollback criteria restated in thread: ERR_RATE > 2% sustained 3m OR p95 latency > 1200ms sustained 3m OR user-facing errors spike > baseline+5 sigma. Marcus, confirm wording for docs?
Marcus: confirm. add note: operator can force pin to previous tag v2.4.0-stable via console if manual rollback needed.
Elena: US canary 2% started, 2:36m in — p50=85ms p95=210ms err_rate=0.12%. No red flags so far.
Priya: EU prewarm done early (10 nodes added). EU warm_pool=6 now. Good to kick EU canary after US 10% step.
Sam: proceeding to 10% US ramp in 2m. @elena track for 10m after ramp.
deploy-bot: US ramp to 10% initiated. Traffic slice updated.
Elena: US at 10% 4m in: p50=88ms p95=230ms err_rate=0.18%. traces show one spike tied to a throttled downstream; raising a quick ticket.
Sam: note the downstream throttling — if it recurs during EU canary we may pause EU. keep me posted.
ops-bot: recording manual holdpoint: if downstream throttle reappears during EU ramp, pause EU and revert EU prewarm allocation after 30m.
Priya: APAC note: we should keep APAC canary after EU stable for full 30m. APAC region has lower reserved capacity; recommend single-node extra warm for initial canary.
Marcus: final: signoff to proceed to EU canary in 10m if US remains stable. leave change window for APAC to be after EU stability. Release notes updated.
Sam: thanks all — I'll post a short runbook in #eng-releases-summary once EU canary is green. :tada:
